description: commands/start.py passes world_accessible_mounts=True, causing container/lifecycle.py to chmod ~/.holon/{proxy-ca,cache,logs} to 0o777 and Root CA private keys to 0o666, while exposing HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB_PASSWORD on docker run -e and mitmweb --set web_password= process argv.
goal: Set world_accessible_mounts=False in src/holon_coherence/commands/start.py (staying at or below its 437-line module budget). Update src/holon_coherence/container/lifecycle.py (staying at or below its 611-line budget, placing new helper functions in src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py within its 200-line budget) so container preparation enforces 0o700 directories and 0o600 private CA keys (never 0o777/0o666), passes HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB_PASSWORD to docker run via a 0o600 --env-file instead of '-e HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB_PASSWORD=...' in argv, and supplies web_password to in-container mitmweb via a 0o600 environment/config mechanism rather than '--set web_password=...' in argv. Update affected assertions and add restrictive permission plus zero-argv-secret regression tests in tests/test_proxy_lifecycle.py, tests/commands/test_start.py, and tests/commands/test_web_token.py. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: World-readable/writable Root CA private keys and CLI-argv web passwords defeat local TLS trust isolation and leak credentials via process tables.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/commands/start.py sets world_accessible_mounts=False and stays within its 437-line budget.

src/holon_coherence/container/lifecycle.py and src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py never set 0o777 dirs or 0o666 CA keys, never emit '-e HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB_PASSWORD=' or '--set web_password=' in subprocess argv, pass secrets via 0o600 files, and stay within 611 / 200 lines respectively.

tests/test_proxy_lifecycle.py, tests/commands/test_start.py, and tests/commands/test_web_token.py verify 0o700/0o600 permissions and absent argv passwords, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass with zero docstrings or comments.
